body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Motorola presented its GSM smartphone ‘MOTO Q9h’ during CES 2008 Unveiled NY Press Review, which runs on Windows Mobile 6.0.

Adopting qwerty keyboard and large display, the Q9h supports Quad-Band(GPRS/EDGE) functionality, video capture and playback at 30fps, and messaging via MMS, SMS, Instant Messaging and Windows Outlook Mobile.
(Picture 1-2: ‘MOTO Q9h’ to be launched through AT&T)
(Picture 3: ‘MOTO Q9m’ to be released via Verizon)
